title: The long watch
lines: dm
Night falls on the Ash Road and the party makes camp in a ruined barn.
a
Pip volunteers for the first watch and climbs into the loft.
b
Sorrel tends the fire and sharpens her knife.
c
Hadrian says he will sleep with his boots on.
dm
Pip hears hoofbeats on the road, far off and slow.
a
Pip whistles softly to wake Sorrel and Hadrian.
dm
A rider stops outside the barn and does not dismount.
b
Sorrel steps to the door and asks what the rider wants.
dm
The rider holds out a sealed letter without a word.
c
Hadrian takes the letter and breaks the seal.
dm
The letter holds a single line: the bridge is already burning.
a
Pip looks back along the road and sees an orange glow on the horizon.
